message:
The other day, I found myself staring at my pantry like it was a magic portal. I had just read about the impending winter storm and thought, "Surely, I can whip up a gourmet meal with a can of corn and a packet of instant oatmeal!" Spoiler alert: I couldn't. 

After a frantic trip to the grocery store (who knew everyone else had the same idea?), I came home with a few essentials and a newfound respect for storm prep. 

Now, I keep a little stash of snacks and easy-to-make meals on hand, just in case I ever find myself in that predicament again. It’s all about the small steps, right? What’s your favorite tip for staying ready without losing your mind? 😊
